summary: Re-ran full backend test suite after fix to _broadcast_initial_pet (no longer mutates db.pets; only appends to db.locations and emits ws pet_update at t=0 and t~0.5s). All 41/41 tests pass, including test_breach_exit_then_enter_events (the previously failing race test) and the four instant-tracking tests (15-digit IMEI persistence, 860-fallback generation, history within 2.5s, ws pet_update within 2.5s).

seed_data_creation: None; tests use their own signup/login flows and seeded Google session.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend is green at 41/41. If further changes are made to pet creation / broadcast / breach detection flows, rerun backend_test.py which already covers the race scenario via test_breach_exit_then_enter_events.
